title: Alex’s Adventures in Numberland / Here’s Looking at Euclid
note: Popular mathematical travel and history connect number concepts with people and applications. This is explanatory nonfiction, not a mathematics course or primarily a children's book. Cases add varied mathematical knowledge, though much is elementary for this reader; reduced utility and fit, not hard exclusion. UK and US titles identify the same work; no separate entry for the alternate title.

Extraterritorial zones, offshore arrangements and jurisdictional choices connect trade, sovereignty and capital. Different legal spaces add concrete mechanisms and strategic constraints. Institutional criticism alone is not V6 or ideological capture. Jurisdictional power central, T12 applies; multinational history avoids T11. Broad historical-to-current development, no single closed period.

Historian-curated excerpts, letters and guiding notes explain the Copernican revolution. The inspected description positions the anthology as historical explanation through selected texts, not reconstruction of a full technical curriculum; H3 not established, eligibility confidence low until sample coverage is broader. Distinct authors supply evidence of changing argument; long excerpts may lower density for an expert. Collection first published 2024; selection/commentary is the nominated new work, not a reprint of one treatise. Historical endpoint approximately Newton's lifetime, 1727.

Comparative circulation and the heart connect evolutionary constraints, organism size and cultural understanding. Explanatory natural history, not cardiac-health advice. Different organisms add mechanisms rather than repetition. Disease is not established as the predominant topic, so T11 zero. Low direct domain fit remains included; broad evolution/history gives no single endpoint.

Genetics, space environments and engineering constraints inform a speculative long-term survival program. Actual biomedical constraints merit more confidence than a five-century roadmap. Stated speculation and a proposed technological vision are not alone V4/V5/V9; no high-confidence foundational veto established from inspected evidence. Separate hazards add learning, while advocacy and far-future extrapolation lower durability and density. Engineering central, ethical argument auxiliary; no thematic deduction.

author: Daron Acemoglu; Simon Johnson
note: Technological change is connected to bargaining, institutional choices and distribution of productivity gains. Cases add different labor and organizational constraints; causal historical synthesis remains debated rather than settled. Reform advocacy does not by itself establish V6. Power over technology and distribution is central, T12 applies. Cross-period millennium-long comparison gives H13 zero; no single-nation deduction.

Publisher explicitly presents the work as teaching individual investors how to manage financial assets. Portfolio construction and fund-selection proficiency are the primary practical purpose. The financial-industry critique and author prestige do not override technical investment training exclusion.

Structural art connects engineering constraints, material economy, form and social choices across bridges and towers. Main value is explanatory design history rather than structural calculation procedures; eligible despite technical sophistication. Distinct structures reveal different constraints, supporting density. Broad cross-period history, no single central endpoint; no thematic deduction.

author: DK; Martin Rees (consultant)
note: Astronomical compendium structured as a comprehensive illustrated reference to objects and phenomena. Main reference function takes precedence over clear general-reader prose, visual quality and prestigious consultant. Excluded as technical/scientific reference, not falsely identified as fiction or automatically as a children's book.

author: DK; BirdLife International; David Burnie
note: Taxonomically organized identification/reference volume profiling more than 1,500 bird species and birdwatching locations. Its main purpose is specialist reference; introductory behavior explanations do not override H3.

author: Frank M. Turner; Richard A. Lofthouse (editor)
note: Accessible intellectual history connects European ideas to social and historical change. Origin as lectures does not make explanatory history a technical curriculum. Contrasting thinkers and contexts add learning rather than isolated personality notes. Philosophy central, T12 applies; no single nation. Stated period ends at the dawn of the twentieth century, approximately 1900; first publication 2015, not source's 2016 reprint.

Unabridged historical scientific treatise defending a cosmological system through mathematical and physical argument in obsolete astronomical context. Reading its main technical argument requires reconstruction of historical mechanics/astronomy; modern translation, dialogue form and historical importance do not override the historical-treatise exclusion. Not excluded as a fictional novel merely because it uses interlocutors.

Private-equity memoir explains transactions, leverage, operational choices and the EMI failure. Multiple industries supply transferable decision constraints, preventing V3; this is not a technical portfolio-management course. Participant access has self-presentation limits. Finance central, T12 applies; multinational investments avoid T11. Broad career account without one central historical episode.

Explanatory stories trace observations and theories across major scientific fields. Historical survey can qualify without being a reference index or technical course. Different discoveries add factual learning, while breadth limits causal depth and novelty for a physicist. No predominant disease topic merely because one section covers disease; broad cross-period coverage, no deductions.

Policy argument links innovation, risk tolerance, regulation and growth to a proposed American future. Publisher's stated aims emphasize policy and technological progress, not recruiting allegiance to a party or leader; the conservative label alone cannot establish V6. Selective diagnosis and optimistic extrapolation lower E and durability. American policy focus warrants both deductions. No closed historical period; present/future proposal central. Conflicting page counts deferred.

Personal fitness and muscle-building programs are the central purpose, including choosing exercises and training for one's body. V7 health/fitness guidance applies; this is a general-user fitness program, not a clinical professional curriculum. Counterfactual score retains scientific explanation and practical specificity. No disease-centered T11 solely from fitness. Verified first publication December 2024 corrects the source's 2023 date.

Publisher describes personal strategies and life guidance for living with ADHD. Clinical/neurodevelopmental support is central rather than detached explanatory science, establishing V7. Condition-focused health advice warrants T11. Examples add applicable distinctions, while length and personal narrative lower provisional density; no full-text audit.

Justice, finance and durable institutions explain medieval origins of state capacity. Concise historical mechanisms transfer beyond local names; not routine institutional reporting. Distinct institutional developments add learning, not brevity alone. Political state formation central, T12 applies; European comparative scope avoids T11. Explicit 1100–1600 period, H13 capped. 1970 original, not 2005 revised edition.

Civilizational change is explained through exchange, migration and interdependence instead of isolated cultural blocks. Multiple links add comparative mechanisms; a broad corrective synthesis can still select examples, so evidence confidence remains low. Historical institutional criticism is not partisan mobilization. Cross-cultural, cross-period account rather than one nation or a central war/political narrative; no thematic deduction or single endpoint.
